text:
jena-cs: Heads up — Balboa onboarding is blocked. Their QA runs show a stream of 429s during SDK init/warmup. Cutover scheduled tomorrow and they need a quick unblock.
jena-cs: Log excerpt they pasted: 
```
POST https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/init
Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral>
X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-2
Response: 429 {"error":"rate_limit", "retry_after": 5}
```
balboa-se: We run 16 parallel warmup containers in CI, plus real-user smoke tests immediately after. Also observed occasional 401s when tokens rotate at the same time.
kai-eng: Pattern sounds like synchronized token rotation + heavy preflight fanout exhausting tenant bucket. Ask for traceroute / egress IPs and tenant id.
jena-cs: Tenant = t-balboa-3. Egress IPs they sent: 34.83.12.45, 34.86.7.191, 198.51.100.18.
ops-bot: anomaly: tenant=t-balboa-3 spike at 2026-05-02T10:14:03Z concurrent_init=18 token_rotate_cluster=6s.
mateo-cs: Immediate customer steps we can recommend: 1) set explicit region/edge in SDK init, 2) cap warmup concurrency to 3-6, 3) add jitter to ephemeral token refresh.
dev-rel: Small RN snippet to share: 
```js
import Redwood from 'redwood-mobile';
Redwood.init({
  apiKey: '__ephemeral__',
  region: 'eu-west-2',
  preflight: { maxConcurrency: 4 },
  auth: { refreshJitterMs: 400 },
  retry: { maxRetries: 3 }
});
```
kai-eng: Ops-side quick options: A) temporary tenant cap bump for 24h, B) accept X-Redwood-Region/X-Edge header as authoritative for preflight only, C) route the provided IPs to eu-west-2 pool. Ops needs a ticket.
balboa-se: We prefer SDK changes first (we control CI) but want ops bump as contingency for the cutover window. Please do both if possible.
ops-bot: ticket INC-9892 created: request temporary preflight cap bump and routing exception for t-balboa-3 until 2026-05-03T13:00:00Z. Tagged infra + edge-team.
kai-eng: I can canary a change to respect X-Edge header for /v1/preflight on canary only (very low blast radius). If ops can do the cap bump, monitoring should show drop in 429s.
dev-rel: Also tell them to upgrade to rn-mobile-sdk v1.0.2 — it has jittered refresh and lowers default preflight concurrency.
jena-cs: I sent the RN snippet and upgrade path. Asked them to limit CI warmup to 4 concurrent jobs and to add jitter. Balboa will test now and report back in 30 min.
ops-bot: update: INC-9892 approved and cap increased. Monitoring enabled.
balboa-se: Quick test return: after throttling CI to 4 and applying jitter we see far fewer 429s in our CI. Thanks. We'll keep the ops bump for cutover.
jena-cs: Great — I\u2019ll close the loop after tomorrow's cutover and post a short onboarding note for future customers about region pinning + token refresh jitter. :+1:
